location_exception_reason: Portable toilets are manufactured commodities with pan-India supply and standardised specifications; location of manufacture or seller does not alter product function or buyer decision. Buyers select by material (FRP/HDPE/MS), style (squat/commode), capacity, and waste management system—not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer', 'Distributor') are redundant in portable toilet titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'FRP Portable Toilet Cabin Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The product is a portable toilet regardless of seller classification.
